title: Eyeglasses in Uptown Houston | Briargrove Eye Center
description: The optical staff at Briargrove Eye Center will help you find the best fit for your specific needs and explain how different lenses and frames will impact your vision.

blocks.html: Contemporary eyewear provides you with much more than sharp vision. Following your [[a href="/eye-care-services/eye-exams/"]]general eye exam[[/a]], our Uptown Houston optical carries the latest European and American designer eyewear collections in a variety of styles, colors, and materials, including titanium, stainless steel, and plastic. Our optical staff looks forward to helping you select the best eyewear for your vision prescription, lifestyle, and unique fashion taste, ensuring you enjoy clear, comfortable vision every day.
